Start with Memote

Memote is a note-taking app that allows you to combine text, tables, and images into one place.
This guide will explain how to use Memote with examples from public relations specialist, Yamanashi, and sales specialist, Takanashi.

Short notes that accompany a page are called "Quick Notes."
Yamanashi keeps important decisions in her Quick Notes.
Yamanashi uses sticky notes to mark important sections.
Each page can have up to ten additional items.

For use by the team
Mr. Kotoharu's sales team first created a workspace.
The area within the workspace where everyone can see is called "hiroba" (Commons).

Anyone can post notes in the "Commons" area.
Mr. Kotoyasu shares his daily sales plans with the team in the "Commons" every morning.
Members can be invited to the workspace via email.
Those who have been invited will receive a confirmation email.

Once approved by the administrator, members can immediately join.
The permissions for each member can also be changed individually.
Synchronization and history

Notes are automatically saved and synchronized across all devices.
You can also edit them offline, and they will be synchronized immediately upon reconnection.
You can revert to a previous version from the page history.
Ms. Tsukimori was able to recover the text she accidentally deleted.

Tips for organizing
It's helpful to pin important pages so you can easily access them.
Pinned pages will be displayed at the top of the list.

Using tags on notes in the "hiroba" (platform) makes them easier to find.
You can create tags freely.
Ms. Kotori Yu divides the tags by project.
The same tag can be used for a single word or phrase.

In the search, you can find both "hiroba" and "hito" at the same time.
If you cannot find what you are looking for, try expanding the search range.
